newsitem.title: PERU: Peru and Mexico seek bilateral free trade accord.
newsitem.headline: Peru and Mexico seek bilateral free trade accord.

text.p: Officials from the governments of Peru and Mexico are meeting in Lima to negotiate a bilateral free trade accord, the Industry Ministry said Wednesday.
"They (Peruvian officials) are meeting behind closed doors with officials from the Mexican government, headed by its trade negotiator Eduardo Solis," a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
He said the talks began Tuesday and would finish Thursday with "a joint declaration on the result" of the negotiations.
According to Peruvian government figures, the two countries have annual bilateral trade of about $400 million.
